Prohibitionist Propaganda Organization Issues Press Release
Offering Their "Expert Opinion" On The Appeals Court Oakland Ruling

If their pathetic web site is indicative, all of the "educational" materials they have are devoted to prohibitionist propaganda against medical marijuana. To understand their game consider the following from The Drug Free America web site

"Available Resources

The Drug Free America Foundation has many educational resources available for anyone interested in learning more about the threat of illegal drugs in America today.

Videotapes:
"Medical" Marijuana: Formula for Disaster
Today, all across America, there is an effort to legalize harmful drugs as "medicine." Many people and organizations have worked for years to soften the public's attitude about illegal drugs, especially marijuana. This informative videotape reveals the hidden agenda behind "medical" marijuana initiatives. It includes a personal message from Former First Lady, Barbara Bush. Produced by the Drug Free America Foundation, Inc. Length: 9 minutes, 30 seconds. Suggested donation: $12.95 (includes shipping and handling.)

"Medical" Marijuana: A Smokescreen

To order call (727) 893-2616 or email us.

(Marijuananews note:The DFAF was founded by Betty Sembler a founder of the notorious "rehab" outfit Straight Inc.)

Mrs. Sembler is the co-founder of the Drug Free America Foundation, Inc., and the founder and president of Save Our Society From Drugs (S.O.S.)."

September 14, 1999

(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sept. 14, 1999--

TOPIC: A California federal appeals court ruled today that marijuana may be distributed to patients who require the drug for a serious medical condition such as chronic pain, AIDS or cancer. The court asked U.S. District Court Judge Charles Breyer to review his October 1998 injunction against the Oakland Cannabis Buyers Cooperative for violating federal anti-drug laws.

See
A Major Disaster For Marijuana Prohibition in Oakland
– Federal Appeals Court Rules For Medical Necessity Defense
